# BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Spiseforstyrrelser

BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Spiseforstyrrelser is a Danish psychiatric clinical unit appearing in the ADHD database's 2024 quality-indicator report, a national dataset tracking how child and adolescent psychiatric departments across Denmark perform on standardized ADHD-assessment measures [^src1][^src2]. The clinic is named in the section of the report covering Indicator 2b, which measures how often clinicians conduct a manualized diagnostic interview or environmental observation as part of ADHD diagnostic workups for children and young people [^src1].

On this measure, BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Spiseforstyrrelser achieved full compliance, reaching 100 percent fulfillment of Indicator 2b, which meets the national development target [^src1]. This places the clinic among the better-performing units in a national picture that, on average, showed only 51 percent fulfillment of Indicator 2b across the country during the reporting period of 01.04.2024–31.03.2025, well short of the 90 percent development goal set by the steering group [^src1]. Elsewhere in the same dataset, however, the clinic is also recorded with a "Nej" (no) status and a 0 percent figure in a different data table (with a range noted as 0-98) [^src2], indicating that its performance varied across the different tables or indicators presented in the report; the source data does not explain the reason for the discrepancy.

The clinic's results sit within a broader national assessment of ADHD diagnostic quality that documents significant regional variation, identifies barriers such as geographic challenges, registration problems, and variable waiting times, and notes that the steering group revised the indicators in response to criticism, in order to better reflect current clinical practice [^src1]. No relationships to other named entities are recorded for this clinic in the available data.
